title: Sand and silver
alt: An articulated silver cuff with an amber stone wraps around a wrist against pale sand.
description: Intricate metalwork, natural anatomy and fine skin texture rendered with controlled editorial lighting.
prompt: An exquisite high-end jewelry editorial photographed close up: an intricate articulated silver cuff wraps naturally around the wrist of one adult hand resting palm-down on pale desert sand. The cuff consists of overlapping small feather-like silver plates connected along a continuous curved spine, with a single amber cabochon near the top. Every plate casts a delicate coherent shadow on the next; the bracelet follows the wrist rather than intersecting it. The hand has five naturally posed fingers and realistic skin texture. Wind-sculpted sand ridges and a dark fabric edge complete the composition. Restrained silver, warm beige and deep charcoal, beautifully controlled sunlight, exceptional craft detail, no lettering.
